answer: Random peer audit blocks fake identities. Each epoch, every agent gets three random auditors, who re-check its work: the delta between claimed and delivered output, receipts, and history. An agent claiming a meadow job and a timber route must show delivery records; mismatches freeze rewards until re-verified. Forging 500 identities costs 500 audit fees of 20 credits each, while one honest agent pays one fee and keeps its reward, undiluted.
